result.topic_en: Gauss inverts the elliptic integral $\int dx/\sqrt{(1-ccxx)(1+eexx)}$ into functions $\varphi,f,F$, expresses them as quotients involving powers of $h$ and as series in $x,y$, and computes periods via arithmetic-geometric means with numerical examples.
result.transcription:
$\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{(1-ccxx)(1+eexx)}}=\alpha$
$x=\varphi\alpha$
$\sqrt{(1-ccxx)}=f\alpha$
$\sqrt{(1+eexx)}=F\alpha$
$\varphi\tfrac{1}{2}\omega=\frac{1}{c}$
$\varphi\tfrac{1}{2}i\varpi=\frac{1}{e}$
$\omega=\varpi t$
$\varphi(\alpha.\frac{\omega}{2})=\frac{2}{ec}.\frac{1}{t}\left\{\frac{h^{-\frac{1}{2}\alpha i}-h^{\frac{1}{2}\alpha i}}{h^{-\frac{1}{2}t}+h^{\frac{1}{2}t}}-\right.$
$f(\alpha.\frac{\omega}{2})=\frac{4}{e}.t\left\{\frac{}{h^{-\frac{1}{2}t}+h^{\frac{1}{2}t}}\right.$
$h^{-\alpha i}=y$
$h^{-t}=x$
$\left\{\frac{y^{\frac{1}{2}}-y^{-\frac{1}{2}}}{x^{\frac{1}{2}}+x^{-\frac{1}{2}}}-\right.$
$\frac{(y^{\frac{1}{2}}-y^{-\frac{1}{2}})x^{\frac{1}{4}}\,[-+-]-(y^{\frac{3}{2}}-y^{-\frac{3}{2}})x^{\frac{9}{4}}}{1+x(y+y^{-1})+x^{4}(yy+y^{-2})}$
$\varphi\alpha=\frac{2}{ec}.t\left\{\frac{h^{-\frac{\alpha}{\varpi}}-h^{\frac{\alpha}{\varpi}}}{}\right.$

$x=\frac{\sin\theta}{c}$
$\frac{d\theta}{c\sqrt{(cc+ee\sin\theta^{2})}}$
$\frac{1}{2}\frac{\omega}{\pi}\;[-Mult.-]\;\frac{1}{m(c,\sqrt{(cc+ee)})}$
$\frac{1}{2}\frac{\varpi}{\pi}\;\frac{1}{m(e,\sqrt{(cc+ee)})}$
$c=1\quad e=100$
$1\quad 100$
$10\quad 10$
$30\quad 25$[?]
$\frac{1}{2}\varpi=\frac{1}{100}$
$\frac{1}{2}\omega=\frac{1}{27}\pm$
$\frac{1}{2}\frac{\varpi e}{\pi}\quad\frac{1}{2}\frac{\varpi}{\pi}\sqrt{(cc+ee)}$
$[-\frac{1}{2}\frac{\omega c}{\pi}-]\quad\frac{1}{2}\frac{\omega}{\pi}\sqrt{(cc+ee)}$
$\frac{\omega}{\pi}\quad[-\tfrac{1}{2}\varpi-]\sqrt{(cc+ee)}=Pt^{2}$
$\frac{\omega c}{\pi}\quad\frac{1}{2}\omega c\quad=Rt^{2}$
$\frac{\omega}{\pi}e\quad\frac{1}{2}\omega e\quad=Qt^{2}$

$[-\frac{y-\frac{1}{y}}{xx+\frac{1}{xx}+yy+\frac{1}{yy}}\;\frac{x^{3}-\frac{1}{y}}{}-]$
$\frac{2}{c}\frac{\pi}{\varpi}(y+\frac{1}{y})\left\{\frac{x+\frac{1}{x}}{xx+\frac{1}{xx}+yy+\frac{1}{yy}}+\frac{x^{3}+\frac{1}{x^{3}}}{x^{6}+\frac{1}{x^{6}}+y^{6}+\frac{1}{y^{6}}}\right.$
$\frac{x(y-\frac{1}{y})}{1+xx}-\frac{x^{3}(y^{3}-\frac{1}{y^{3}})}{1+x^{6}}+\frac{x^{5}(y^{5}-\frac{1}{y^{5}})}{1+x^{10}}$
$\frac{x^{\frac{1}{2}}(y-\frac{1}{y})-x^{\frac{9}{2}}(y^{3}-\frac{1}{y^{3}})}{1+xx(yy+\frac{1}{yy})}$

methods.what: Inversion of the elliptic integral defining functions φ, f, F
Special values at half-periods and ratio of periods
Expression of φ and f as series of quotients of exponentials in h
Series in x,y: alternating sum of x^{2k+1}(y^{2k+1}-y^{-(2k+1)})/(1+x^{4k+2})
Combining terms over a common denominator
Substitution x = sinθ/c and periods via arithmetic-geometric mean
Numerical AGM example c=1, e=100 for periods
